moments.title: Strictly Icons Week Live Show
moments.blurb: Tonight's Strictly Come Dancing saw celebrities perform to iconic tracks for 'Icons Week', with results to be announced tomorrow.

angles.name: Live Show Recap
angles.copy: Icons Week on Strictly! Who brought their A-game and who’s on the bottom of the leaderboard after tonight’s performances? Catch the results show tomorrow! #Strictly

angles.name: Madonna & Dolly Tributes
